name: Hazeroth
overview: Hazeroth is identified in Scripture as a significant station during the journeyings of the children of Israel in the wilderness. The people of Israel traveled from Kibrothhattaavah to Hazeroth, where they stayed for a time before continuing their journey toward Paran and other locations. This place is noted in the narrative of their wilderness encampments, marking a pivotal point in their route as they moved toward the Promised Land.
